question:
**Direction: Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.**

It is a **__misconception__** that the more you learn, the more likely you are to succeed.
solution:
The correct answer is **"Certainty."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given word is **misconception**, which means a mistaken belief or idea. ((किसी बात के विषय में) भ्रांत धारणा, ग़लतफ़हमी)

 
 
• **Example**: *It is a proper **misconception**__.*
 
 
 
• The opposite of "**misconception"** is "**certainty."**
 
• **Certainty** means a state of being completely sure or confident. (अवश्‍यंभाविता, निश्चितता)
 __
 
• **Example**: *We can’t say with **certainty__** that there is life on other planets.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is option 4.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: Illusion** means a false idea or belief. (निराधार विचार, धारणा या प्रभाव; भ्रम)
 
• **Option 2: Hallucination** means seeing or hearing things that are not really there. ((बीमारी या नशे में होने वाला) दृष्टिभ्रम या मतिभ्रम, (ऐसी बातें देखना या सुनना जो वस्‍तुतः हैं नहीं); निर्मूलभ्रम)
 
• **Option 3: Fallacy** means a mistaken belief or idea. (झूठा विश्‍वास या भ्रांत धारणा)
